description: This file contains the implementation of the PDO class within the Opencart System Library, responsible for handling database interactions via PDO in PHP. It includes methods for connecting to the database, executing queries, escaping strings, and retrieving metadata such as last insert ID and affected rows.

classes.name: PDO
classes.description: A wrapper class for PHP's PDO providing simplified database interaction methods such as query execution, escaping, and retrieving last insert ID, tailored for use within OpenCart's framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new database connection using provided host, username, password, database name, and optional port.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, handles result fetching, and tracks affected rows.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Prepares a string for safe use in SQL queries and stores it in the data array for parameter binding.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from the database connection.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
